item.title: Yuushien Garden: Peonies and Ginseng on Daikonshima — Guide
item.description: Yuushien is a beautiful Japanese strolling garden on Daikonshima, a volcanic island in Lake Nakaumi near Matsue. It is best known for peonies: the island is a major grower, and the garden displays them year-round, most spectacularly in a winter arrangement of hundreds of blooms floating on the surface of the pond. Around a central pond with waterfalls and stepping stones, the garden also grows Korean ginseng, another local speciality, and glows with azaleas in spring and maples in autumn.
